cinematic-drum-big.what: A giant drum struck hard: the crack of the stick and a big, deep boom.

cinematic-thunder-big.what: A thunderclap: a sharp crack and a rolling rumble.

cinematic-metal-big.what: A big metal hit: a deep clang of steel ringing on.

boom-hit-strong.what: A big, deep boom that fills the room.

boom-hit-medium.what: A deep, rounded boom with a warm hall.

boom-drop-medium.what: A deep drop: a boom sinking, with a low roll under it.

bass-sub-drop-medium.what: A sub drop of about two seconds: deep and falling, felt more than heard.

bass-sub-drop-short.what: A short sub drop: a deep tone dropping away, about a second.

bass-rumble-medium.what: A low rumble of about three seconds: distant thunder, the ground shaking.

impact-deep-hard.what: A deep, hard hit: a crisp crack over a heavy, rumbling low end.

riser-1s-soft.what: A 1-second soft, airy rise that builds to its peak at the end.

riser-2s-soft.what: A 2-second soft, airy rise that builds to its peak at the end.

riser-1s-strong.what: A 1-second strong, bright rise that builds to its peak at the end.

reverse-whoosh-short-strong.what: A short strong, bright reverse whoosh: air drawn in, building to a sudden stop.

reverse-whoosh-medium-soft.what: A soft reverse whoosh: air drawn in, building to a sudden stop.

whoosh-slow-soft.what: A long, soft breath of air drifting past.

whoosh-medium-soft.what: A smooth, gentle sweep of air that rises and fades without an edge.

foley-paper-slide.what: Paper sliding across a desk: a soft, dry hiss.

foley-paper-touch.what: A sheet of paper handled: a quick crinkle and rustle.

props-page-turn.what: A page turning: lifted at the corner, swung over and falling flat.

mechanical-shutter-heavy.what: A camera's mirror and shutter: a fuller, slower ka-chunk.

time-clock.what: A clock ticking: tick, tock, once a second.

time-clock-fast.what: Fast, urgent ticking: twice a second.

writing-pen-draw.what: A pen on paper, drawing a few long strokes.
